about.cells: base = o0p0, pnrK = o0pK, synthK = oKpK, oOpP = (order O, placement setting P)
about.free_flow_unit: order mean (mean of the placements of one statement order); circuits summarised by the mean of their order means (orders weighted equally); n_eff = number of orders
about.preserve_unit: placement run (one netlist; one run per placement setting)
about.order_variance: s2_order = var(order means) - s2_place * mean(1/n_o); s2_place = pooled within-order variance; balanced core (>= 3 orders x >= 2 common settings) used when present
about.tests: one-sided Welch t and exact permutation (difference of means, all splits) on the units. Welch, Holm: over every (pair, measure, configuration) test of the inversions table. Permutation, Holm: within each pair-measure over its configurations. All six: intersection-union p (largest of the six), Holm over the 22 pair-measures (19 pairs)
about.old_pooled: every run as an independent observation (the previous analysis), for comparison
about.observations: circuit|library|flow -> order -> placement setting -> [area, delay, adp, power]

fresh.what: free flows: orders 3-5 (3 order means); preserve: placements 4-5 (2 runs); none of it seen before the balanced set was chosen

without_selection_order.what: free flows: orders 1-5 (order 0, the netlist of the selection run o0p0, left out); preserve: placements 1-5 (o0p0 left out)
